name: Big Health (Sleepio, Daylight)
short_description: FDA-cleared prescription digital therapeutics for chronic insomnia (SleepioRx) and generalized anxiety disorder (DaylightRx), with Medicare coverage effective January 2025.
long_description: Big Health offers FDA-cleared prescription digital therapeutics for two of the most prevalent mental health conditions: chronic insomnia (SleepioRx) and generalized anxiety disorder (DaylightRx). SleepioRx, cleared in August 2024, delivers Cognitive Behavioral Therapy for Insomnia (CBT-I) as a 90-day treatment, with clinical trials showing 76% of patients achieve improvement. DaylightRx, cleared in September 2024, is the first FDA-cleared digital treatment for GAD, with 71% improvement rates. Both products received Medicare coverage effective January 2025 through new CMS Digital Mental Health Treatment (DMHT) G-codes - a landmark achievement for the DTx industry. Big Health's employer-focused model features utilization-based pricing with no PEPM fees, billing through PBM integration. The company raised $23.7M in February 2026 to accelerate adoption and has supported over 750,000 individuals.
one_liner: First FDA-cleared DTx for anxiety (DaylightRx) and insomnia (SleepioRx) with Medicare coverage.

seo.title: Big Health: FDA-Cleared SleepioRx & DaylightRx DTx | HeyPsych
seo.meta_description: SleepioRx (insomnia) and DaylightRx (anxiety) are FDA-cleared digital therapeutics with Medicare coverage as of January 2025. 76% and 71% improvement rates.

faqs.a: Yes, SleepioRx received FDA clearance on August 8, 2024 for treatment of chronic insomnia in adults 18+ as an adjunct to usual care. It delivers CBT-I through a 90-day digital program.

faqs.q: Is DaylightRx FDA approved for anxiety?
faqs.a: Yes, DaylightRx received FDA clearance on September 4, 2024, becoming the first FDA-cleared digital treatment for generalized anxiety disorder (GAD) in adults 22+.

faqs.q: Does Medicare cover SleepioRx and DaylightRx?
faqs.a: Yes, as of January 1, 2025, CMS established new DMHT G-codes enabling Medicare Fee-for-Service and Medicare Advantage coverage for SleepioRx and DaylightRx.

faqs.q: How effective is SleepioRx for insomnia?
faqs.a: Clinical studies show 76% of SleepioRx patients achieve improvement in insomnia. The product has been tested in 26 clinical trials including 18 RCTs.
